lines: I intend to write this down accurately. You stood with us when it mattered.
Some deeds deserve more than a margin note. Yours may be one of them.
The account will say you came when the village needed help.
I saw a story turn because someone chose not to flee.
There are records of raids and records of people who stopped them. You earned a line.
The village archive remains intact. So do we, thanks in part to you.
I'll remember the facts: danger came, and you answered.
Some deeds sound exaggerated until one sees them from a doorway.
When danger came close, nobody had time to sound brave first.
You learn a lot about a village when everyone hears the bell at once.
